changelog:
Initial release of aliyun-docmind-extract for Aliyun Document Mind (DocMind) via Node.js SDK.

- Provides async job submission and polling for document parsing (structure, text, layout) using DocMind.
- Includes usage examples for both URL-based and local file uploads.
- Guides users in setting up credentials and environment variables.
- Documents error handling, polling intervals, and output validation workflow.
- Designed for integration with Claude Code/Codex document understanding pipelines.
